decision.standaloneOven: Do not create. Accepted 750 range visibly includes a fixed cast-iron oven door, dials and body. No internal oven cavity, operable oven door, heat source or cooking behavior certified.
decision.standaloneBedding: Do not create. All22 reopened accepted bed files contain editable native authoring scenes with embedded bedding. Twenty later authoring files name mattress, cover and pillow parts with independent bedding/cover channels; the two early source files also retain separately editable native furniture and fabric parts. Core sleeping scenes use accepted beds unchanged. No separate independently placeable bedding catalogue item claimed.
